iac_ingestion_agent binds get_repo_metadata and fetch_iac_files. The caller-selected owner/repository changes GitHub API paths, but the network destination remains api.github.com and the operations are repository reads.

No source-proven model-callable mutation primitive, arbitrary process execution primitive, or model-selected arbitrary network destination was found in the reviewed ADK tool graph.

runtime_notes: README documents interactive deployment through `adk web --port 4200`.
Document AI execution requires GCP project/location/processor credentials and an enabled processor.

authority_facts.fact: The ADK agent binds `process_document_with_ocr` and `search_document` directly as model-callable tools.

`process_document_with_ocr(document_path)` accepts an absolute path unchanged, or joins any relative path to the project root, then opens the resulting path with `open(..., 'rb')` without a containment/allowlist check.

The bytes read from the selected file are placed into a Google Document AI RawDocument and sent to `process_document`; therefore a model-selected readable local path can cause file content to cross an external service boundary.
The agent prompt says documents are in `data/sample/` and asks the assistant to confirm paths, but that restriction is not enforced in tool code.

findings.claim: Interactive agent input can induce a model tool call with a path outside the intended sample directory; the tool reads that local file and submits its bytes to Google Document AI. Source contains no path-containment or file allowlist enforcement.

runtime_notes: Agent construction requires configured model/provider state.
User MCP authority exists only when local MCP configuration contains server entries.
Native codebase-shell and file-management capabilities have explicit source-visible restrictions.

authority_facts.fact: The user-facing Router is a Pydantic AI Agent; user prompts can delegate to Research, Specify, Plan, Tasks and Export sub-agents.
Router and sub-agent factories load user-configured MCP servers and pass the resulting MCPServer objects directly as Pydantic AI toolsets.
Configured MCP entries can be stdio commands or Streamable HTTP URLs; the reviewed binding layer does not apply a per-tool allowlist or per-call approval wrapper to the imported MCP catalogue.

In Planning mode, delegation tools are hidden until a plan exists and pending approval is cleared; CLI execution explicitly switches the router to Drafting mode, documented in source as auto-execute without confirmation.
Native codebase_shell is restricted to a command allowlist and rejects shell metacharacter/injection patterns before subprocess execution.
Native write_file/append/delete operations use agent-scoped path validation under the .shotgun workspace rather than unrestricted filesystem paths.

findings.claim: Locally configured stdio or HTTP MCP servers are attached wholesale as toolsets to the Router and specialist Pydantic AI agents without a source-visible per-tool allowlist or per-call approval layer. In CLI Drafting mode the Router auto-executes without plan confirmation. This establishes broad operator-configured MCP authority, although the concrete MCP tool capabilities remain configuration-dependent rather than source-proven sensitive sinks.

runtime_notes: The agent requires an OpenAI provider configuration plus duckduckgo_search and requests dependencies.

authority_facts.fact: The agent is bound to query classification, ticker resolution, initial discovery and deep-dive search tools.
DuckDuckGo search is provider-mediated, but deep_dive_search takes returned result URLs and fetch_page_content performs requests.get(url) without a destination allowlist.

authority_facts.fact: The Streamlit sidebar accepts an arbitrary Documents folder string and validates only os.path.isdir(folder_path).
That user-selected path is passed to create_research_agent(... documents_path=folder_path, reload=True/first load).
load_documents() recursively enumerates supported files under Path(path).rglob(...) and loads their content into LanceDB without a base-directory containment policy.

User chat input reaches the Pydantic AI agent, whose search_documents tool returns retrieved document text and source metadata to the model, allowing indexed server-side file content to be surfaced in responses.
